facts: GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER is unique for each run of a particular workflow, increases for each new run, and is unchanged on re-run.
GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT begins at one and increases on re-run.
Exact run GET exposes id, workflow_id, run_number, run_attempt, repository, branch, head and event metadata.

inference: For a fixed numeric workflow ID, equality current.run_number = predecessor.run_number + 1 admits at most one new run; deletion does not supply a distinct new run with the same unique sequence number. This is inferred from the documented unique monotonic numbering, not a separate documented delete/reset guarantee.
